description: This Java class defines a REST API resource for managing post-dated checks (PDCs) associated with loans in the Fineract platform. It includes endpoints for retrieving all PDCs for a loan, fetching individual checks, updating or marking checks as bounced, and deleting checks.

classes.name: RepaymentWithPostDatedChecksApiResource
classes.description: A REST controller providing endpoints to manage post-dated checks associated with loans, including retrieval, update, and deletion functionalities.

methods.name: getPostDatedChecks
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all post-dated checks for a specific loan.

methods.name: getPostDatedCheck
methods.description: Fetches details of a specific post-dated check by installment ID and loan ID.

methods.name: updatePostDatedChecks
methods.description: Updates or marks a post-dated check as bounced based on the editType parameter.

methods.name: deletePostDatedCheck
methods.description: Deletes a post-dated check based on its ID and associated loan ID.
